Select canonical_smiles, substrate_record_id, metabolite_record_id, substrate_compound_key, metabolite_compound_key, met_conversion, pathway_key from metabolism. Inner join compound_records on metabolism.substrate_record_id = compound_records.record_id to get substrate_compound_key. Inner join compound_structures on that compound_records.molregno = compound_structures.molregno to get canonical_smiles. Left join compound_records on metabolism.metabolite_record_id = compound_records.record_id to get metabolite_compound_key. Do not add sorting; preserve source row order. Limit to first 200 rows.
